numericalComparison.inventoryCorrection: M3 first comparison exposed two omitted elapsed-timing keys. Confirmed totalMs uses elapsed(startedAt)/factorizationMs+solveMs in solver/sparse/solveSparse.js; totalFactorizationMs is factor timing, not a numerical tolerance. No engineering or qualification field excluded.

phase26Migration.reason: Phase21~25 added capability to the elastic result and changed two summary semantics. Measured against the frozen Phase20 archive: 0 keys removed and 0 engineering values changed (displacement, force, reaction and residual are identical). Only the fields listed here differ, so the archive stays frozen and the additions are recorded instead of re-archived.

migratedFields.productVersion: version string advanced with the Direct P-Delta product
migratedFields.ok: design.ok now means designComplete, so a model with no failing check but open practical RC checks reports false
migratedFields.skippedMembers: the summary counts skipped members against the practical evaluation instead of the legacy concrete module

phase26Migration.rule: Fields in addedFields may be present live and absent in the archive. Fields in migratedFields are compared for presence only. Every other key is still compared exactly, and a removed key is a failure.

performance.noiseRetry: Only rerun both versions if sample spread exceeds 20 percent; retain both attempts.
